load_or_initialize_atlas_model: load or initialize an Atlas model from checkpoint or fresh T5 and Contriever components
save_atlas_model: save an Atlas model with optimizer and scheduler state to a checkpoint directory
load_retriever: load a Contriever-based retriever as tied or untied dual encoder from pretrained weights
load_reader: load a FiD reader model and tokenizer from pretrained weights with optional crossattention support
create_checkpoint_directories: create checkpoint and index directories for saving Atlas model artifacts during training
